idea: Golu leaves the fridge open to cool the kitchen; open fridge heats the room
Golu runs the fan in an empty room to cool it; fans cool people (sweat evaporation), not the air
Dadi says the matka keeps water colder than Buntys imported steel bottle; evaporation through porous clay cools the water
Dadaji's glasses fog up over tapri chai, Raju's ice hack makes it worse; steam condenses on the cold lens
Gupta Uncle races Golu on the swings with heavy imported shoes and a gold chain and loses to the small swing; a swing's period depends on rope length, not weight
